scope: Whole surviving built campus of former Castle Air Force Base: all84 current native building/tank footprints inside the Castle Airport and two adjoining former-base commercial precincts, plus its actual mapped aircraft-control tower. Ten hangars, operations/administration/training/support buildings and storage tanks retain distinct native positions and open gaps; no whole property extrusion. Reconstruct whole perimeter/roof of every mapped building with bounded original architectural sections, representative industrial openings and roof detail. Separate outdoor museum/display aircraft, later prison, town housing, detached historical family-housing annexes, runways/taxiways/aprons, landscaping and interiors excluded.
